approved_by: Adi Nahon (reviewed by Claude; approved on PR merge)
summary_he: זהו הסקיל הרשמי של shadcn/ui לניהול רכיבים, פריסטים ומערכות עיצוב באמצעות ה-CLI של shadcn, יחד עם כללי סגנון וקומפוזיציה מפורטים. לא נמצאו גניבת סודות, הסתרה או הזרקת הוראות. עם זאת, הסקיל מריץ אוטומטית `npx shadcn@latest` בטעינה (גרסה לא נעוצה מ-npm), ומתקין קוד מרג'יסטריז של צד שלישי, ולכן מומלץ להיות מודעים לסיכון.

concerns.issue: Dynamic context injection (!`npx shadcn@latest info --json`) runs a shell command automatically when the skill loads. It downloads and executes the latest unpinned shadcn package from npm. This is the official tool and matches the stated purpose, but a compromised npm release would execute without any user action.

Encourages adding components from community and third-party registries (@magicui, @bundui, owner/repo GitHub, arbitrary URLs). Those writes install unreviewed third-party source code and npm dependencies into the project. The skill partially mitigates this by requiring the user to name the registry explicitly and recommending --dry-run/--view and reviewing added files.
Instructs the agent to fetch documentation and example URLs (ui.shadcn.com, raw.githubusercontent.com) returned by the CLI. This is network access to well-known hosts.
Design-system workflow runs `add --all -y` and `init ... -y` (skipping confirmation prompts) and installs npm font packages. These are scoped to a newly scaffolded app.
Documents registry config with Authorization headers resolved from env vars (${MY_TOKEN}). This is user-configured and only sent to the user's own registries, so it is not exfiltration.
